title: Role-Augmented Intent-Driven Generative Search Engine Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2508.11158v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Generative search engines (GSEs), which combine large language models (LLMs) with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), are reshaping how users access Web information and making source visibility and influence in generated responses new optimization objectives. Existing generative search engine optimization (G-SEO) methods seek to improve content visibility, but many rely on direct access to target queries or GSE feedback elicited by those queries. However, Web content is typically optimized and published before future user queries are known, making G-SEO without access to target queries or their associated feedback an important yet underexplored problem. To address this, we propose RAID, a Role-Augmented Intent-Driven G-SEO method that operates without access to target queries or query-dependent GSE feedback. RAID infers a primary retrieval intent from source content, refines it through 4W multi-role deep reflection on prospec

translated_title: 角色增强的意图驱动生成式搜索引擎优化
translated_abstract: 生成式搜索引擎（GSEs）将大语言模型（LLMs）与检索增强生成（RAG）相结合，正在重塑用户获取网络信息的方式，并使内容来源在生成回答中的可见度和影响力成为新的优化目标。现有的生成式搜索引擎优化（G-SEO）方法致力于提升内容可见度，但许多方法依赖于直接访问目标查询或由这些查询引出的GSE反馈。然而，网络内容通常在未来的用户查询尚未知晓时就已经被优化和发布，这使得在无法获取目标查询或其相关反馈的情况下进行G-SEO成为一个重要但尚未被充分探索的问题。为解决这一问题，我们提出了RAID，一种角色增强的意图驱动的G-SEO方法，它无需访问目标查询或依赖查询的GSE反馈即可运行。RAID从源内容中推断主要的检索意图，并通过对潜在查询场景进行4W多角色深度反思来细化该意图。
tldr: 提出RAID方法，通过从源内容推断检索意图并进行4W多角色深度反思，实现了在无需访问目标查询及其反馈的情况下进行生成式搜索引擎优化。
en_tdlr: Proposes RAID, a role-augmented intent-driven method that enables generative search engine optimization without access to target queries by inferring retrieval intent from source content and refining it through 4W multi-role deep reflection.
